name: pebble-logo
title_zh: 纸黏土质感图标生成器，边缘故意裁出画框感
tagline_zh: 想要毛绒绒的纸黏土或剪贴画图标？它把圆润造型、哑光阴影和故意裁切边缘一次做齐，适合启动器、头像或成套品牌家族。
tagline_en: Round organic mascots with matte shading and intentional edge crops—for launcher icons, avatars, or a coordinated.
desc_en: Generate distinctive paper-clay or cut-paper mascot app icons with rounded organic shapes, tactile matte shading, and intentional edge crops. Use when the user names Pebble Logo or requests a paper-clay, cut-paper, tactile matte, edge-peeking mascot style for launcher icons, avatars, or a coordinated logo family. Do not trigger for generic logo or avatar requests without this visual direction.
why_zh: 不是滤镜套壳。它从造型到光影都按纸黏土/剪贴画物理特性生成，边缘裁切是设计决策而非失误。
why_en: Not a filter. It models clay/cut-paper physics—rounded forms, matte depth, deliberate crops—so icons feel handmade, not.
limit_zh: 只认纸黏土/剪贴画/哑光/边缘裁切这类视觉方向；普通图标或头像请求不触发。产出为单张图，不负责多尺寸导出或图标排版。
limit_en: Only triggers on paper-clay/cut-paper/matte/edge-crop styles. Generic icon/avatar requests ignored. Outputs single images—no multi-size export or.
title_en: Paper-clay mascot icons with tactile matte & edge crops
